scope: Pinned vendor source TxS on-wire correlation investigation, no protocol changes
findings: TXS_D_4 contains 8-bit PID and 12-bit SN; TXS_D_3 contains 8-bit WLAN index; TXS_D_1 exposes timestamp
TX descriptor has 12-bit SN and sn_vld; descriptor existence does not prove beacon builder sets it or exact hardware echo behavior
ParseTxSPacket removes status by PID before callback; original beacon callback indexes current BSS using software Priv
Original beacon SN/timestamp are recorded only under DBG and not compared against expected submission identity
Candidate software reservation generation is not an on-wire TxS field; host-only generation cannot disambiguate reused PID
Explicit sn_vld assignments found only in chip short-template setup and set zero; this template is not itself proof of beacon descriptor path
missing_evidence: Exact beacon submission path SN assignment and hardware override for MT7603 E1/E2
Meaning/time domain and wrap behavior of TxS timestamp for beacon reports
Firmware/hardware contract for duplicate/late report delivery and PID reuse boundary
Safe per-BSS FIFO drain/completion that preserves Main/Guest, or equivalent demonstrably unique on-wire correlation
decision: Investigate existing PID+SN/timestamp further; no safe reuse/reopen fix proven. Do not enable active OPEN release, invent cookie field or use bounded delay as proof.
cleanup: Archive streamed in memory, no vendor extraction retained
sequence_search_scope: All pinned mt76x3 .c/.h scanned for explicit ->/.sn_vld assignment and txd_3/txd3->sn assignment; aliases, raw MMIO and other names not excluded
